waves.title: Week runtime indicator rerun implementation and closeout
waves.goal: Re-run the bounded Week runtime indicator implementation and evidence lane without widening the approved Week helper-state slice.
verification_commands: corepack pnpm --dir frontend exec jest --runInBand test/app/week-page.test.tsx
acceptance_criteria: The Week DEV chip remains compact in collapsed state.
On /week in non-production, tapping the chip expands and collapses a local disclosure with render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Week render-path labels are derived from existing page states and remain stable for canonical, in_progress, empty, error, auth_gate, and loading branches.
Production and non-Week routes remain inert and visually unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed, dev-expanded, and prod-unchanged Week proof plus an explicit FLOW-TODAY-WEEK-WEEK observability verdict.
Reviewer evidence explicitly checks that the Week top area remains local and not banner-like.
deferred_work: Any additional diagnostics fields beyond render path, bootstrap result, and current mode.
Any Day or multi-route redesign of the shell badge beyond the bounded / and /week helper entry points.
Any backend observability or payload diagnostics exposure in user-facing UI.
